hypotheses.statement: Structured control flow (nested loops with break/continue, internal recursion, early return) produces identical storage, return values, and events on solc/anvil and solang/pallet-contracts at moderate input scales; divergence risk is concentrated near resource limits, not in control-flow semantics themselves.

evidence.note: nestedLoops(6) with break/continue, recurse(5) via factorial, earlyReturn(3) hitting both branches, and loopAccum(1000) all matched: counter/lastLoop storage, return values, and LoopDone event identical; no divergence in control-flow semantics at these scales.

hypotheses.next_probe: Call loopAccum with increasing n (e.g. 10k, 100k, 1M) on both chains to find the point where one chain runs out of gas/weight while the other still succeeds, exposing the metering-model threshold.
